title: What Survives Distillation? A Mechanistic Interpretability Study of GPT-2 and DistilGPT-2
abstract: arXiv:2610.37157v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge distillation compresses large language models into compact students that preserve aggregate metrics, yet the mechanistic consequences of depth-reduction distillation remain largely uncharacterized. This work applies linear CKA, logit lens analysis, attention pattern decomposition, sparse autoencoder feature statistics, and activation patching to compare GPT-2 and its six-layer student DistilGPT-2 across two canonical circuits: the Indirect Object Identification (IOI) circuit and the Greater-Than (GT) circuit. The results reveal a compression-collapse dichotomy: the IOI circuit suffers complete mechanistic collapse (DistilGPT-2: 35.2% accuracy vs. 94.8%, zero name-mover preservation), while the GT circuit survives with 87.7% task performance recovery through active remapping of the teacher's layer-9 comparison head into student layer~4 (mean Pearson r = 0.945). These findings demonstrate that circuit compressibility governs mech

translated_title: 什么在蒸馏中幸存？GPT-2与DistilGPT-2的机制可解释性研究
translated_abstract: 知识蒸馏将大型语言模型压缩为能够保持聚合性能指标的紧凑学生模型，然而深度缩减蒸馏在机制层面造成的后果在很大程度上仍未被刻画。本工作应用线性CKA、logit lens分析、注意力模式分解、稀疏自编码器特征统计以及激活补丁等方法，在两个经典回路上比较GPT-2及其六层学生模型DistilGPT-2：间接宾语识别（IOI）回路与大于比较（GT）回路。结果揭示了一种“压缩-崩溃”二分现象：IOI回路遭受了完全的机制性崩溃（DistilGPT-2准确率为35.2%，而教师模型为94.8%，名称移动头零保留），而GT回路则通过将教师模型第9层的比较头主动重映射到学生模型第4层（平均Pearson r = 0.945），实现了87.7%的任务性能恢复。这些发现表明，回路的可压缩性决定了蒸馏在机制层面的结局。
tldr: 该研究揭示GPT-2蒸馏为DistilGPT-2时存在“压缩-崩溃”二分现象：IOI回路发生完全机制崩溃，而GT回路通过将教师模型第9层比较头重映射到学生第4层而幸存，表明回路的可压缩性决定了蒸馏的机制后果。
en_tdlr: This study reveals a compression-collapse dichotomy when GPT-2 is distilled into DistilGPT-2: the IOI circuit completely collapses while the Greater-Than circuit survives by remapping the teacher's layer-9 comparison head into the student's layer 4, demonstrating that circuit compressibility governs the mechanistic consequences of distillation.
